name: scrcpy
description: Android device screen mirroring and control over USB/WiFi with minimal latency

tools.description: Android Debug Bridge for device communication and debugging
tools.usage:
adb devices # List connected devices
adb shell # Interactive device shell
adb install app.apk # Install application
adb pull /sdcard/file.txt . # Download file from device
adb push file.txt /sdcard/ # Upload file to device

tools.description: Display and control Android devices over USB/WiFi with low latency
tools.usage:
scrcpy # Mirror default device
scrcpy -s DEVICE_ID # Specific device
scrcpy --max-size 1024 # Limit resolution
scrcpy --record file.mp4 # Record session
scrcpy --turn-screen-off # Turn off device screen
